metadata.name: TextSize
metadata.description: Guides > Following the user's text size. fontScaling and maxFontScale, on every component that draws text, and the app-wide defaults (SwiftJsonUIConfiguration.shared.font.scaling / maxScale, KotlinJsonUI Configuration.Font.scaling / maxScale, the web Configuration.Font.configureScaling). Five sections: the two attributes, what each platform writes, the app defaults, the web lengths measured in a browser, and what the page measured and did not.

uiVariables.name: nextReadLinks
uiVariables.description: Three closing cards: writing layouts, screen readers, the Label reference.

notes: 2026-11-14 — New page (standing order: every new feature gets its article; the orchestrator asked for the attribute list and a Dynamic Type page). No earlier page covered text size.

Section 2's block is converter output for a Label with fontSize 13 under no declaration, fontScaling false, fontScaling true (web only) and maxFontScale 1.5: rjui LabelConverter, sjui ConverterFactory, kjui ComposeBuilder.generate_component, called directly.

Section 4's table: the four web lengths set as font-size on spans in headless Chromium (playwright, chromium_headless_shell), html font-size 16px and 32px, then --jui-font-unit: 1px and --jui-font-max: 1.5px as configureScaling writes them (read from the Configuration.ts template), read with getComputedStyle.

Read from source, not run: SwiftJsonUI FontScaling.swift (capStep rounds down to a Dynamic Type step; keepsEnvironmentFont), KotlinJsonUI Configuration.kt (Font.scaling, Font.maxScale). Android's non-linear scaling and three-platform parity at 2.0 are the libraries' and jsonui-cli's word.

This site sets neither custom property; its size classes each resolve to their plain size (every [font-size:min(...)] pairs with the Tailwind class of the same size, every text-[length:min(...)] reduces to a plain rem), and the built CSS contains all 17 distinct classes.

2026-11-14: section_defaults_bullet_provider added. rjui LabelConverter writes ...Configuration.Font.resolve({...}) for a text with or without fontSize; jui build on this site printed 'Updated Configuration template ... (it was an earlier rjui template, unchanged)'; every inline size and weight equals the classes beside it (4079 elements), the 104 family calls are unchanged, and the 5 with weight semibold map to 600, where the browser would drop 'semibold' (headless Chromium: style.fontWeight='semibold' -> dropped, computed 400). Android's routing is jsonui-cli's word.
